unsupported_inference: The zero-return frame count from a no-input probe is not independently established as the content-level animation length or as the unplayed airborne tail. The within-run matches support a fit to that probe-derived value, not the claimed general mechanic.
preserved_observations: Landing was operationally identified by M+0x78 equaling 0x02.
obj+0x72 at landing was measured as the elapsed value.
Lag was measured as the first frame obj+0x18 equaled 1 with RIGHT held, minus the landing frame.
The no-input probe recorded the state path and the frame when control returned.
The probe-derived animation-length values were recorded in prior runs before fresh predictions, so the proposed input was known before each later outcome.
The formula matched 12/12 and 11/11 rows within the two promoting runs.
The later preregistered cross-run test produced 6 exact matches and 15 misses, including the listed hit and miss rows.
missing_evidence: An independent content-level animation length from ROM, animation data, or another source.
A fresh preregistered comparison using that independently obtained length, including the cross-run miss cases.
next_test: Read the relevant animation length independently from ROM or equivalent content data, then preregister and run one fresh held-RIGHT landing-lag test covering a previously missed case.
